approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 XEX to native ARM64, own kernel/XAM runtime, RexGlue Vulkan GPU backend
help: Xbox save storage and device selector
notes: Runs on Android ARM64 (tested on Lenovo Legion Y700 Gen 4). Reaches the title screen with controller input and a local offline profile sign-in; menus and levels are not reached yet. No audio decoding, no save storage yet. You must supply your own Xbox 360 copy of the game; no game files are included.
